[CGMZ] Plugin Commands
By: Casper Gaming
Last Update: February 14, 2026
Latest Version: 1.8.0
​
Adds some plugin commands that are meant to make some things with the default editor easier, such as turning a switch on/off if an event is within certain xy coordinates or controlling self switches for any event and much more.
Adds lots of plugin commands for controlling switches, timer, and more
Control any event's self switch
Request autosaves or call scenes
Spoiler:
Screenshots
Event knows which region ID it is in
Event can call scenes individually without needing to go through main menu
Import into plugin manager and enable the plugin. Some customization options are able to be altered. Further instructions in plugin.
Online documentation can be found on my
website
.
User documentation can be found on the
Casper Gaming Wiki
.

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, this plugin received an update today to version 1.3.0.
This update adds a few new plugin commands. There are some quality of life ones, such as Stop All Sound which will stop BGM/BGS/SE/ME in one command, and Erase All Pictures which will erase every picture in one command.
There is also a new plugin command, Change Battle Lose, which allows you to configure if the player receives a gameover after losing a random battle or not. This will only affect random battles.
This update also added Spanish language help documentation.
Version 1.3.0
Added plugin command to allow the player to lose battle without gameover
Added plugin command to stop all sound (BGM/BGS/ME/SE)
Added plugin command to erase all pictures
Added Spanish language help documentation

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.4.0!
This version adds some new plugin commands for a more flexible wait command than the built in event wait.
The first new plugin command is called Wait (Range) and you provide a min and max amount of frames to wait. The plugin will choose a random value in the given range to wait.
The second plugin command is called Wait (Variable) and allows you to wait for an amount of frames based on the value of a game variable.
Version 1.4.0
Added plugin command to wait within a given range
Added plugin command to wait for an amount of frames by variable

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi all, today this plugin was updated to version 1.8.0!
This version adds a plugin command to change the weather power and screen tint values by adding or subtracting from the current value. By default, you can only set a new power (for example, snow 6 or snow 9). Sometimes, you may want to add or subtract from this value, and you may not always know what to set it to without some complex event or scripting.
These new plugin commands allow you to simple add or subtract 1, 2, 3, etc from the current weather value. The tint plugin command allows you to add or subtract red, green, blue, or gray. The tints have safety checks to ensure you do not go out of range (-255 to 255 or 0 to 255 for gray). The weather has a safety check to ensure you do not go below 0, but you can exceed the default limit of weather power 9 by adding more to your weather if you want.
Version 1.8.0
Added plugin command to add or subtract weather power
Added plugin command to add or subtract screen tint values
